title: ASCII palindrome filter
prompt: Input {"text": string}. Keep only ASCII letters A-Z/a-z and digits 0-9; compare case-insensitively. Return true iff the filtered string is a palindrome. Empty filtered text is a palindrome.

input.text: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!

title: Gregorian leap year
prompt: Input {"year": integer 1..9999}. Return true iff it is a Gregorian leap year (divisible by 400, or divisible by 4 but not 100).

title: Multiplicative persistence
prompt: Input {"n": nonnegative integer <= 1,000,000,000,000}. Repeatedly replace n with the product of its decimal digits until it is a one-digit number. Return the number of replacements; one-digit inputs yield 0.

title: Integer to Roman numeral
prompt: Input {"n": integer 1..3999}. Return the standard uppercase minimal Roman numeral, using subtractive forms IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM.

title: 24-hour clock to 12-hour clock
prompt: Input {"time": string HH:MM} where HH is 00..23 and MM is 00..59. Return string "hh:mm AM" or "hh:mm PM"; hh is always two digits (01..12).

title: Validate ISBN-10
prompt: Input {"code": string}. Ignore spaces and hyphens. Return true iff ten characters remain, the first nine are decimal digits, the last is a digit or uppercase X (value 10), and the ISBN-10 weighted checksum sum(10-i)*digit[i] is divisible by 11.

title: Transpose rectangular matrix
prompt: Input {"matrix": rectangular list of integer lists}. Return its transpose. Input [] returns []; nonempty matrices may contain zero columns. Output lists are in row-major order.

title: Parse unsigned binary number
prompt: Input {"bits": nonempty string of 0/1, length 1..60}. Return the nonnegative decimal integer represented by the bits, allowing leading zeros.

title: ASCII Caesar cipher
prompt: Input {"text": string, "shift": integer -1000..1000}. Shift only ASCII letters cyclically by shift; preserve letter case and leave digits, punctuation and all other characters unchanged.

title: Weekday of ISO date
prompt: Input {"date": valid ISO date YYYY-MM-DD between 1900-01-01 and 2100-12-31}. Return its English uppercase weekday name: MONDAY through SUNDAY.

title: Parse one CSV record
prompt: Input {"row": one valid CSV record without embedded newlines}. Return list of fields. Comma separates unquoted fields; double quotes protect commas, and inside quoted fields two adjacent double quotes represent one literal double quote. Preserve leading/trailing spaces and empty fields; empty input returns [""].

title: IPv4 CIDR network address
prompt: Input {"ip": canonical dotted-decimal IPv4 address, "prefix": integer 0..32}. Return normalized network address as "a.b.c.d/prefix" after zeroing host bits.

title: Clockwise spiral matrix traversal
prompt: Input {"matrix": rectangular list of integer rows}. Return entries visited clockwise from top-left: top row, right column, bottom row reversed, left column upward, repeating. Empty matrix or zero columns returns [].

title: Rotate square matrix clockwise
prompt: Input {"matrix": N×N integer matrix, N>=0}. Return a new matrix after rotating by 90 degrees clockwise. [] returns [].

title: Evaluate polynomial in descending coefficient order
prompt: Input {"coeff": integers [a_d,...,a_0], "x": integer}. Return a_d*x^d+...+a_0. Empty coefficient list represents the zero polynomial. Input constraints guarantee a signed 64-bit result and intermediate Horner values.

title: Repeatedly remove adjacent K-groups
prompt: Input {"text": lowercase ASCII string, "k": integer 1..5}. Repeatedly remove a group whenever k consecutive equal letters appear; after removal, newly adjacent groups may also vanish. Return remaining text.

title: Josephus circle winner
prompt: Input {"n": integer 1..10000, "k": integer 1..1000}. People numbered 1..n form a circle; remove every kth person, counting inclusively from person 1 and resuming after each removal. Return the 1-based number of the survivor.

title: Count subarrays with target sum
prompt: Input {"nums": list of signed integers, "k": signed integer}. Return the number of NONEMPTY contiguous subarrays whose sum is exactly k. Input length <= 100, result fits signed 64-bit.

title: Count obstacle-avoiding right/down paths
prompt: Input {"grid": rectangular matrix of 0=open and 1=blocked cells, dimensions <=12x12}. From top-left to bottom-right, move only right or down through open cells. Return number of valid paths; empty grid or blocked endpoint gives 0.

title: Exact-word and prefix queries
prompt: Input {"words": list of lowercase words, "queries": list of {"type":"exact"|"prefix", "word": lowercase string}}. Return a boolean for each query in order. "exact" matches complete words; "prefix" is true when any stored word starts with the query, including empty prefix if words is nonempty.

title: Multiply integer matrices
prompt: Input {"a": R×K integer matrix, "b": K×C integer matrix}. Return R×C matrix product. Constraints: R,K,C >=1 and <=7, each element -10..10.

title: Validate partially filled Sudoku
prompt: Input {"board": list of nine strings, length 9 each, with characters . or 1..9}. Return true iff no digit repeats in any row, column or 3×3 box. Ignore dots; a complete solution is NOT required.

title: Critical path duration in a DAG
prompt: Input {"duration": nonnegative integer duration per node, "edges": list of [u,v] meaning u must finish before v starts}. Nodes are 0-based, graph is a DAG, n<=20. Tasks may run in parallel. Return the earliest time all tasks can finish, or 0 for no tasks.

title: Evaluate plus/minus parentheses expression
prompt: Input {"expression": valid expression made of decimal nonnegative integer literals, +, -, parentheses and spaces, with unary + or - allowed}. Return signed integer mathematical value. No multiplication or division; intermediate results fit signed 64-bit.

title: Restore possible dotted IPv4 addresses
prompt: Input {"digits": string of 0..12 decimal digits}. Insert three dots to form valid IPv4 addresses; segments must be 0..255 with no leading zeros except "0". Return all valid addresses in ascending lexicographic order, without duplicates.

title: Count distinct palindromic substrings
prompt: Input {"text": lowercase ASCII string length <=80}. Return the number of DISTINCT nonempty palindromic contiguous substrings. Equal substrings at different positions count once.

title: Maximum XOR of two elements
prompt: Input {"nums": list of at least two nonnegative integers <=1,000,000}. Return the maximum bitwise XOR across pairs of DISTINCT indices.

title: Count per-user events in an inclusive time window
prompt: Input {"events": list of {"user": string, "minute": integer}, "start": integer, "end": integer}, with start<=end. Count events for each user whose minute lies in [start,end]. Return JSON object mapping only participating users to counts.

title: Minimum jumps to last index
prompt: Input {"nums": nonempty list of nonnegative integers}, where each number is the maximum forward jump from that index. Start at index 0. Return the smallest jumps to index n-1, or -1 if unreachable; a singleton returns 0.

title: Area covered by axis-aligned rectangles
prompt: Input {"rectangles": list of [x1,y1,x2,y2] integer coordinates with x1<x2 and y1<y2}. Return the total geometric UNION area; overlaps count once, touching borders do not add overlap. Empty list returns 0.

title: Multiply arbitrarily long decimal strings
prompt: Input {"a": unsigned decimal string, "b": unsigned decimal string}, each 1..40 digits, leading zeros allowed. Return their exact product as a normalized decimal string with no leading zeros except "0". No floating point.

title: Count array inversions
prompt: Input {"nums": integer list}. Return number of index pairs i<j with nums[i]>nums[j]. Equal elements do not count; empty list returns 0.

title: Range additions and range sums
prompt: Input {"nums": integer list, "operations": list of ["add",l,r,v] or ["sum",l,r]}; indices 0<=l<=r<len(nums) inclusive. Adds modify the current array; each "sum" appends the current inclusive range sum to output list.

title: Maximum bipartite matching size
prompt: Input {"left": L, "right": R, "edges": list of [u,v] with 0<=u<L and 0<=v<R}, L,R<=12. Return the maximum number of disjoint left-to-right pairs. Duplicate edges are allowed.

title: Burst balloons for maximum coins
prompt: Input {"nums": list of nonnegative integers 0..9, length <=8}. Each turn pop one balloon; coins gained equal left_neighbor * popped * right_neighbor, taking missing neighbors as 1. Return maximum total coins across possible removal orders; empty list gives 0.

title: Count constrained N-Queens placements
prompt: Input {"n": integer 1..9, "blocked": list of [row,col] cells with 0-based coordinates}. Count placements of n queens on an n×n board so no queens share row, column or diagonal and no queen is in a blocked cell. Duplicate blocked cells do not change the count.

title: All parenthesized arithmetic results
prompt: Input {"expression": string of 1..6 nonnegative integer operands separated by binary +, - or * with no spaces}. Return the sorted list of integer results for ALL binary parenthesizations, retaining duplicates when multiple parenthesizations yield the same result.

title: Count distinct subsequence embeddings
prompt: Input {"source": lowercase string, "target": lowercase string}, length <=20. Return number of index sequences in source whose characters form target in order. Empty target has exactly one embedding.

title: Longest palindromic subsequence length
prompt: Input {"text": lowercase string length <=70}. Return maximum length of a not-necessarily-contiguous palindromic subsequence. Empty text returns 0.

title: Max-profit nonoverlapping job schedule
prompt: Input {"jobs": list of [start,end,profit] with start<end and nonnegative profit}. Select a subset maximizing sum of profit; jobs may touch (previous end <= next start). Return maximum achievable profit, 0 if none.
